name: show_pairing
description: Show what links a device: a QR to scan and/or a code to type, large and copyable, under the label, with the help (markdown) when given. Call it again as it changes; it updates in place. Only shows it; there is no reply.

code.description: A code to type or send, shown large and copyable

expiresAt.description: When the QR or code stops working, an ISO instant; shown as a countdown under it

help.description: What to do with it, markdown

label.description: What is being linked, e.g. Link your WhatsApp

link.description: A link that opens the app with the code typed in, e.g. sms: or wa.me

linkLabel.description: What the link's button says, e.g. Open in Messages

qr.description: What the QR encodes: a link or a pairing string

qrLabel.description: What the QR is for, under it, e.g. Scan with your iPhone
